name: InvoiceOps Reconcile Posted Invoice v1
description: Reconcile posted InvoiceOps rows and build an accounting evidence pack. Read-only only.

steps.command: [t:invoiceops/reconcile -> reconciliation_result] frame_id=$inputs.frame_id; invoice_number=$inputs.invoice_number; posting_plan_id=$inputs.posting_plan_id; runtime_data_dir=$inputs.runtime_data_dir; profile=service; fixture_mode=true; write_report=true

[t:invoiceops/evidence_pack -> accounting_evidence_pack] frame_id=$inputs.frame_id; invoice_number=$inputs.invoice_number; posting_plan_id=$inputs.posting_plan_id; runtime_data_dir=$inputs.runtime_data_dir; profile=service; fixture_mode=true; write_report=true
